traces.claim: Offline event diagnosis; no new service execution, inferred latency saving, or persistent residency claim.

comparison.scope: Observed whole-trace second minus first, not simulated latency or per-event causal estimate.
limitations: ID pairing alone does not prove matched causal pre-state; use the original intervention audit.
Zero observed peer work delta does not establish no evictions; eviction attribution is unobserved.
Scheduled positions are executed scheduler work, not measured GPU time.

cpu_fixture.evidence_layer: existing native CPU fixture, not service trace
